title: Weighing "El Gordo" with a Precision Scale: Hubble Space Telescope Weak-lensing Analysis of the Merging Galaxy Cluster ACT-CL J0102-4915 at z=0.87

evidence.locator: Sect. IV.2 and Figure 8: the shear peaks are at R.A. 01:02:50.601, Decl. -49:15:04.48 (north-western) and R.A. 01:02:56.312, Decl. -49:16:23.15 (south-eastern), two subclusters about 700 kpc apart, each centroid constrained to about 4 arcsec; the X-ray and south-eastern mass peaks are about 8 arcsec apart. Sect. IV.3: two NFW halos are fitted; the small line-of-sight velocity difference and the double radio relics favour a merger nearly in the plane of the sky, and no study has yet constrained the three-dimensional geometry.
